scope: Exact source/blob/selector component contract and complete literal component oracle only. No component checker executed, no product edits/native builds/model campaign, no full replay or acceptance claim.
first_review_retained: independent-first-review.json preserves S01-S05 against contract-draft01. No first finding or failed outcome was erased.

dispositions.evidence: Aliases receive length-first<=32, ASCII and exact pinned pattern-search before equality/sorting. Key dictionaries must be exact builtin dict of length3 with only fixed builtin string names before fixed-name snapshots. Invalid aliases have explicit SOURCE_KEY_SHAPE.

Canonical Base64 syntax/quartets/padding/zero pad bits are preflighted; exact decoded size is calculated and per-item/cumulative limits applied before decoder allocation. Malformed Base64 wins over oversized decoded length; no allocation above4096 is admitted.

JSON-Blob twenty-digit/depth/work subprofile is explicit. Resource refusal maps BLOB_JSON_RESOURCE separately from BLOB_CANONICAL_JSON, and the contract explicitly says a21digit canonical JSON integer is not inherently noncanonical. M12 freezes the resource case.
Inequality gives DIFFERS first. EMPTY_SOURCE_MATCH_NONPROBATIVE requires empty source, [0,0) and equal empty quote. M14/M15 separately freeze empty equality and nonempty quote mismatch.

Exact Q_RECORDS alias/logical-source name is excluded with SOURCE_RESERVED_Q_RECORDS, after duplicate checks but before alias-set comparison. Body raw is charged once as reserved Q_RECORDS; physical aliases are never deduplicated. M17 freezes reserved alias rejection.

oracle_review.coverage: Eighteen manually declared complete-result cases cover ordinary MATCH, well-bound DIFFERS, raw response digest tamper, source hash/length mismatch, missing alias, equal alias copies, aggregate exact/over boundary, source-count exhaustion, canonical JSON/resource refusal, opaque invalid UTF8, empty-source equality/inequality, nonempty empty-slice refusal, reserved Q_RECORDS and unequal bytes under one key.
oracle_review.complete_results: Each expected.json contains an entire component result, not a subset of a ReplayResult. Successful expected envelopes include complete body pin, source/blob indexes and selector statuses; failed envelopes contain only exact status/stage/error.
observed_artifact_checks: Every oracle per-file byte count and SHA256 matches its actual body/originals/expected artifact.
Every candidate Body is exact canonical JSON bytes.
Successful result body pins match candidate Body bytes; source/blob indexes are exact ordered projections of their declared records and preserve all aliases.
Successful envelopes retain UNVERIFIED/NONE/UNKNOWN and contain no accepted_result or body/decoded-content copy; error envelopes contain no partial indexes.
All PREPARATION dependency and output byte counts/digests match current files. No dependency implementation was executed by this review.
oracle_review.scope_limit: Literal behavioral statuses were manually reviewed against the contract, not generated by the component. Artifact consistency checks do not prove membership implementation correctness, complete input coverage or a formal resource theorem. The larger independent adversarial suite remains separate.

resource_and_refusal_observations: Exact source copies plus Body Q_RECORDS consume the ordinary source count/byte intersection; checking actual lengths precedes hashing/copying, and supplied sources remain opaque.
Per-role alias/blob/selector uniqueness is enforced here; global cross-role ID and semantic reference closure remains an explicit later gate.
Complete quote integrity is checked before any selector range/membership result. Blob encoding is checked immediately after each Blob integrity check, before advancing to the next Blob.
Pinned identifier newline behavior remains unchanged; source SHA shape is full lowercase64hex. No blanket fullmatch strengthening is admitted.
Output is bounded SOURCE_BLOB_SELECTOR_ONLY; source authentication/currentness/English entailment are not established.
